_readme: GT (2026-10-02, owner ruling D6): the STARTER ALLOWLIST for the per-bar runtime pane.
While PINE_RUNTIME_STAGE is admins, cohort or all, the runtime lane draws ONLY a script whose
Pine source sha256 (UTF-8, as written) starts with one of the sha256 values below or one
in the PINE_RUNTIME_ALLOWLIST variable on web (the server reads the union, per request).
Every other script declines by name (runtime:not-yet-graded) with the host lane's sentence.
ADD A SCRIPT ONLY WHEN A TRADINGVIEW CAPTURE GRADES IT MATCH: one object per script, naming
the capture. Read by api/services/runtime_definitions.py::allow_list. An empty list serves
nothing. Edit this file as text; never round-trip it through a serialiser.
WS-I (2026-10-31, owner ruling R1): a script below is SERVED only when it passes
api/services/rollout_gate.py::pine_runtime_admission, in this order:
1. PER-CAPABILITY CONFORMANCE (the primary gate). `capabilities` names every census
capability the script uses (the ids of tools/pine_coverage/coverage_map.py::FEATURES;
tests/test_pine_runtime_switch_on.py holds the list to the census detector, so it can
never under-declare), and EVERY one of them must be `conformant` in the `capabilities`
registry at the bottom of this file, with evidence named.
2. AT LEAST ONE MATCH CAPTURE. `captures` names a TradingView capture of THIS script
(tests/fixtures/vendor/harness/<id>.json, its source hashing to `sha256`) graded MATCH
with the runtime pane ON.
A committed script that fails either is WITHHELD (served as not graded, never deleted) and
tests/test_pine_runtime_switch_on.py goes red BY NAME, so an ungraded line cannot be
committed by accident. A capability marked `divergent` withholds every script that uses it:
`conditional-ta` (R4) is that row until WS-C lands per-call-site history.

reassign.note: := reassignment of a series variable across bars, graded MATCH with the runtime pane on (PHASE3-RUNTIME-PLAN 2.4).

ternary.note: ?: on series values, graded MATCH with the runtime pane on (PHASE3-RUNTIME-PLAN 2.4).

conditional-ta.note: R4 (2026-10-31): a pure ta.* called inside if, a loop or a UDF is computed from EVERY bar on the plot lane (pineRuntimeFrontend.js:1518-1563), not per call site. Withholds every script that names it until WS-C lands per-call-site history; the by-name refusal in the front end is WS-C's first task.
